notice_title.text: Periodic KYC Updation Mandate & Account Regularization Notice (Savings Account #4092187342)
notice_title.evidence_quote: Subject: Periodic KYC Updation Mandate for Account No. 4092187342

issuing_organisation.text: Apex National Bank Ltd., Central Retail Banking & Customer Verification Operations
issuing_organisation.evidence_quote: Issued by: Apex National Bank Ltd., Central Retail Banking Division

affected_party.text: Account Holder(s) of Savings Account No. 4092187342
affected_party.evidence_quote: Dear Customer, Account No: 4092187342, Branch: Connaught Place

main_purpose.text: Complete mandatory re-KYC document verification within 30 days to avoid account operation restrictions and transaction debit freeze
main_purpose.evidence_quote: You are requested to submit fresh KYC documents within 30 days of this circular to prevent temporary debit restriction.

plain_language_summary.what_is_this: This is an official periodic KYC update notice from your bank under regulatory compliance guidelines.
plain_language_summary.why_it_matters: Failure to update identification records will cause your bank account to be classified as inoperative with an automatic debit freeze.
plain_language_summary.what_to_do: Submit updated self-attested identity proof (Aadhaar/Passport/Voter ID) and recent photograph online or at your branch.
plain_language_summary.where_to_do_it: Complete online via Video-KYC on https://netbanking.apexbank.com/re-kyc or visit any bank branch counter.
plain_language_summary.if_deadline_missed: Debit transactions, ATM withdrawals, and UPI payments will be blocked after December 15, 2026 until in-person re-activation.

deadlines.description: Final deadline for completing re-KYC documentation before transaction freeze.
deadlines.evidence_quote: All KYC documents must be verified and updated on or before 15-12-2026.

required_documents.name: Officially Valid Document (OVD) for Address Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport)
required_documents.evidence_quote: Self-attested photocopy of any Officially Valid Document (OVD) is mandatory for address re-verification.

required_documents.name: Permanent Account Number (PAN) Card or Form 60
required_documents.evidence_quote: Copy of PAN card or signed Form 60 declaration must be tendered.

required_documents.name: Recent Passport Size Color Photograph
required_documents.evidence_quote: One recent passport size color photograph taken within the last 3 months.

required_documents.name: Passbook Copy for Signature Verification
required_documents.evidence_quote: Customer may present original passbook if updating recorded signature style (optional).

submission_channel.channel: Apex NetBanking Portal (https://netbanking.apexbank.com/re-kyc) or Home Branch Helpdesk
submission_channel.evidence_quote: Customers may verify via Video-KYC at https://netbanking.apexbank.com/re-kyc or at any home branch.

penalties.description: Temporary freeze on outgoing debit transactions, ATM withdrawals, and net-banking transfers
penalties.evidence_quote: Account will be subjected to total debit freeze preventing all automated clearing and ATM withdrawals.

penalties.description: Account classified as dormant/inoperative requiring branch manager clearance to unfreeze
penalties.evidence_quote: Subsequent failure will classify account as inoperative per regulatory norms.

action_steps.action: Access Video-KYC portal at https://netbanking.apexbank.com/re-kyc or visit your nearest home branch.
action_steps.evidence_quote: Step 1: Access Video-KYC portal at https://netbanking.apexbank.com/re-kyc or visit your nearest home branch.

action_steps.action: Submit self-attested photocopies of Aadhaar and PAN along with signed Re-KYC declaration form.
action_steps.evidence_quote: Step 2: Submit self-attested photocopies of Aadhaar and PAN along with signed Re-KYC declaration form.

action_steps.action: Verify mobile OTP and obtain branch acknowledgment receipt or digital tracking service ticket.
action_steps.evidence_quote: Step 3: Verify mobile OTP and obtain branch acknowledgment receipt or digital tracking service ticket.

warnings.warning_text: Bank officials will never ask for PIN, password, or CVV; do not share credentials over phone calls.
warnings.evidence_quote: Bank officials never request passwords, card PINs or OTPs under the guise of KYC updating.
